controls.name: Low/Std/High
controls.implementation: Keep the current three buttons and effort values; shell is visual only.

controls.name: SYNC
controls.implementation: Preserve current sync behavior; rotate existing gear icon while syncing.

controls.name: VOICE ON
controls.implementation: Move knob with CSS; preserve current toggle state and handler.

controls.name: BG picker
controls.implementation: Use a small gear badge without changing the existing picker.

controls.name: Draft Reply
controls.implementation: Idle when no communication is selected. Ready when an Inbox or Calls & Voicemail item is selected. Generate an editable draft; never send automatically.

controls.name: Create Task
controls.implementation: Idle when no source item is selected. Create an editable task proposal containing title, source, and suggested due date; require confirmation before saving.
